top_signals.title: How the Iran War Is Making Alaskans Both Richer and Poorer
top_signals.summary: Oil prices have surged across the United States as a result of the ongoing war in Iran. This means higher costs for households in most states, but in Alaska, the state government is bringing in new revenue from its high oil production to offset those higher costs. Some of the revenue is then redistributed to Alaskans through the state’s unique sovereign wealth fund. While most Americans disapprove of the war in Iran, Alaska may emerge as a quiet winner from one of the conflict’s most painful economic side effects: higher oil prices. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: European troops set to train in Poland for postwar Ukraine deployment
top_signals.summary: Britain and France will lead 2,800 troops from 11 nations in a two-week exercise testing how to move, protect and supply a force to rebuild Ukraine’s military after the war ends.

top_signals.title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card details, personal data and crypto wallet information
top_signals.summary: The crypto debit card provider said customer funds remained safe despite the exposure of sensitive financial and personal information.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
